ai.seo_question: What is the structure of Imam Ali's sermon in Nahj al-Balagha regarding fear of God?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, a seminal collection of sermons, letters, and sayings compiled by Sharif al-Radi, highlighting Imam Ali’s rhetorical mastery in structuring discourse. It establishes the classic khutbah format of praising Allah (hamd), commending the Prophet (salawat), and offering moral exhortation (wa'z), which serves as the foundation for the detailed reflections on God-consciousness (taqwa) and the Day of Judgment that follow.
